title: V3 三市场固定复制独立统计审查

checks: equal-market endpoint combination despite unequal sample sizes

limitations: First identified model evaluation on these three markets followed prior source QC and partitioning. After this run their test performance is exposed.
Authors cleaned daily transaction mean prices; these are not close prices or certified historical vintages.
BJ/TJ primary macro excludes CQ. Unequal sample counts do not change equal-market weights.
Four primary contrasts plus two secondary allocation_readout contrasts comprise one six-contrast multiplicity family.
Macro intervals combine separate-market endpoints using a union bound; no cross-market independence assumption. Short dependent samples still make percentile coverage approximate.
Length20 and40 results both remain. CQ40 is deliberately omitted because40>=28; CQ20 is only descriptive.
If any bootstrap denominator is zero, that market/length CI is unavailable rather than silently dropping undefined draws.
Epoch0 is the native initialization, sometimes already a useful forecast. Positive total gain is not automatically a learned gain.
Softplus constrained coefficients and affine unconstrained coefficients have unequal initial effective update derivatives; sign restrictions are not isolated.
Strong validation selector is context, not a replacement for fixed RW/structural comparisons.
Later SWEWT-GRU supplemental baselines are outside this frozen run/family and are not added to its hypothesis family.

scientific_assessment.primary: Full improves the Beijing/Tianjin macro ratio overRW by18.983248%, but Beijing and Tianjin directions differ and full is worse than constant in the primary macro. The volume comparison to shock_size has positive point estimates at both primary markets, while frozen block intervals remain wide and cross zero.
scientific_assessment.secondary: The pre-specified allocation_readout has macro risk.790512252 and improves onRW at both markets, but does not beat constant in both. It remains a secondary result within the frozen six-contrast family, not a relabeled primary.
scientific_assessment.inference: All six macro marginal95% and simultaneous95% intervals cross zero under both fixed block lengths. This conservative short-sample result is inconclusive for universal mechanism improvement and is not proof of no predictive value.
scientific_assessment.cq: Chongqing28origins is reported separately as a stress test and excluded from the primary macro and multiplicity family.
